newsitem.title: FRANCE: French communists seek higher minimum wage.
newsitem.headline: French communists seek higher minimum wage.

text.p: French Communist Party leader Robert Hue said on Monday he had two priorities if the Left wins power in the parliamentary election -- raising the minimum wage and creation of more public sector jobs.
"From July, we need a big recovery in consumption helped by a rise in salaries, buying power and pensions," he told France Info radio.
He said he wanted an immediate 1,000 franc rise in the minimum wage, now more than 6,000 francs, and a further increase later.
Another immediate aim would be the creation of "thousands of jobs, hundreds of thousands of necessary jobs" in the public sector, he said.

The French vote in a two-round poll on May 25 and June 1. Recent opinion polls have suggested that the race has tightened with the ruling centre-right's lead over the Socialists and other leftwing parties shrinking.
